name: Naomi Kimba
source: Freshman Adderin Naomi wants to seem like a cold-hearted bitch to everyone, but she's actually a pretty sweet and vulnerable girl. Her parents are respected and influential mages who expect their daughter to be able to carry on the family business with dignity.
